question.title: Will heavy rain disrupt last-mile delivery operations in Warsaw on 2026-06-03?
question.background: Generated by explicit source-handoff setup forecast execution after accepted source intake and method gating.
question.resolutionCriteria: Resolve Yes if the declared operations source reports at least one weather-coded delivery disruption in Warsaw on 2026-06-03 and the declared weather observation source records daily precipitation of at least 20 millimeters. Resolve No otherwise.
